title: A Primer of the Armored Fist
summary: Teaches a first-day student to buckle on a gauntlet and throw its first straight blows and covers with plain body strength.

title: Gauntlet Wearer's Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of repeated strikes and covers for students whose skin is hardened enough to carry a steel glove.

title: Fitting and Fighting in the Steel Glove
summary: Covers how to fit the glove snugly and the strikes blocks and grips its weight makes easier than bare hands.

title: Handbook of the Plated Back-Hand
summary: A short handbook on striking and covering with the steel back of the glove for students with strong tendons.

title: Workbook of Cuff and Fist
summary: A workbook pairing forearm cuff blocks with armored fist counters for students whose bones are set hard enough to trade blows.

title: A Guide to Qi in the Gauntleted Strike
summary: Shows a student who circulates qi how to send it into the steel glove at the instant of impact.

title: Canon of the Hinged Fingers
summary: A canon on using the jointed steel fingers to seize hook and tear at a guard once qi can reach the hand.

title: Short Course on the Mail-Backed Grip
summary: A brief course for gauntlets with a mail back on closing the grip shedding cuts and holding a struggling limb.

title: A Treatise on Vambrace Parries
summary: A treatise on stopping spears swords and clubs with the armored forearm while qi stiffens the steel at contact.

title: Daily Exercises in the Weighted Fist
summary: Daily exercises for adding qi weight to a steel fist so each blow lands heavier without wearying the arm.
